heading: 'Angikaaram' OTT release date: When and where to stream Kotapadi J Rajesh and Sindhoori Vishwanath's sports drama
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in /  Sep 21, 2026, 12:43 IST
paragraphs: Tamil sports drama 'Angikaaram' is set to make its digital debut following its theatrical release earlier this year
The movie, which features Kotapadi J Rajesh and Sindhoori Vishwanath was directed by Thenpathiyan
The film marks Kotapadi J Rajesh's debut as a feature filmmaker.When will 'Angikaaram' release on OTT?'Angikaaram' will begin streaming on Sun NXT on September 25
The streaming service shared the OTT update with a caption that gives a glimpse into the film's central conflict. "His only crime was daring to dream
Based on true events."What is 'Angikaaram' about?The movie centres on Aathiran played by Kotapadi J Rajesh
He is a talented runner who comes from a financially struggling family
His sporting abilities give him an opportunity to compete at the Commonwealth Games.However his path to the international sporting event is disrupted when his name is removed from the selection
Aathiran refuses to accept the decision quietly and takes the matter to court
His legal battle brings him into conflict with people who hold great influence within the sporting system

The story explores his attempt to challenge the circumstances that threaten his career.'Angikaaram' explores an athlete's struggleThe film uses Aathiran's journey to examine the difficulties faced by athletes without influential support
The conflict eventually takes the protagonist into the courtroom
His fight becomes more than an attempt to reclaim a place in a sporting event
Mansoor Ali Khan plays a minister connected to the conflict
Rama portrays Aathiran's mother, while Sindhoori Vishwanath is also part of the principal cast.What did ETimes say about 'Angikaaram'?ETimes gave 'Angikaaram' 2.5 stars out of 5
The review highlighted Kotapadi J Rajesh's performance and his physical preparation for the role."What keeps it watchable is Rajesh
For a producer turned actor, his debut is committed and physically convincing, with a real athlete's build and effort behind it
Ghibran's score works hard to pump in an urgency the writing mostly lacks

The subject, the way institutional politics smothers talent from the bottom rungs, deserves a film."The review also noted the contribution of composer Ghibran, particularly in creating intensity during the film's dramatic portions
With the OTT release, ' Angikaaram' is expected to gain wide reach among the audiences who missed it on the big screen.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more
